headline: Veralto (NYSE:VLTO) Misses Q4 CY2025 Sales Expectations
summary: Water analytics and treatment company Veralto (NYSE:VLTO) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025 as sales rose 3.8% year on year to $1.40 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.04 per share was 6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
